Emma Johnson | June 10–20, 2024

Diamond Head hike

☐ Small daypack
☐ Reusable water bottle

Sightseeing, North Shore road trip and shopping
☐ Lightweight casual outfits for the trip
☐ Comfortable walking shoes
☐ Underwear and sleepwear
☐ Light layer and lightweight rain jacket
☐ Reusable shopping bag

Luau and hotel spa
☐ Smart-casual outfit for the luau
☐ Sandals

☐ Identification and any required travel documents
☐ Flight, accommodation and activity confirmations
☐ Wallet, payment cards and some cash
☐ Phone and charger
☐ Camera, charger and memory card
☐ Portable power bank
☐ Toiletries
☐ Prescription medications and basic first-aid supplies

Before packing
